title: The Impact of Early Colleges on Postsecondary Performance and Completion
summary_en: This article updates findings from a 17-year longitudinal experimental study on early colleges, examining the impact on postsecondary performance and completion.
title_cn: The Impact of Early Colleges on Postsecondary Performance and Completion

title: Governing The Accelerator: The Case for National Collaboration in AI-Enabled Materials Discovery
summary_en: This perspective examines how federally funded research and development centers can close gaps across three domains: data and infrastructure, algorithmic intelligence, and autonomous experimentation.
title_cn: Governing The Accelerator: The Case for National Collaboration in AI-Enabled Materials Discovery

title: The Emerging Digital Battleground: The Critical Factors That Produce Advantage in the U.S.-China Competition for Digital Networks
summary_en: Digital infrastructure is now central to the U.S.-China rivalry. The authors identify nine factors that shape competition in global markets and offer five strategic priorities for the United States.
title_cn: The Emerging Digital Battleground: The Critical Factors That Produce Advantage in the U.S.-China Competition for Digital Networks

title: Infinite Potential—Insights On Artificial Intelligence Loss of Control Across Five Scenarios: After-Action Report from a Sequence of Day After Artificial General Intelligence Exercises
summary_en: The authors analyze observations from Infinite Potential games with AI loss of control to identify issues, capabilities, and recommendations needed to navigate the potential collapse of social legitimacy, economic stability, and technical control.
title_cn: Infinite Potential—Insights On Artificial Intelligence Loss of Control Across Five Scenarios: After-Action Report from a Sequence of Day After Artificial General Intelligence Exercises

title: Assessing Chinese and U.S. Technology Diffusion Capacity
summary_en: The U.S.-China tech rivalry hinges not only on innovation but also on achieving widespread technological diffusion in the economy. This report examines both countries’ capacity to convert technological progress into sustained productivity gains.
title_cn: Assessing Chinese and U.S. Technology Diffusion Capacity

title: Infinite Potential—Insights from the European Games: After-Action Report from a Sequence of Day After Artificial General Intelligence Exercises
summary_en: The authors synthesize observations from tabletop games on artificial intelligence conducted in Europe or with European scenarios and identify the key issues and capabilities that players deemed necessary to navigate AI’s potential adverse effects.
title_cn: Infinite Potential—Insights from the European Games: After-Action Report from a Sequence of Day After Artificial General Intelligence Exercises

title: Mapping Complex Legislation: Applying the RAND U.S. Code Analysis Tool to the One Big Beautiful Bill Act
summary_en: The authors applied RAND’s U.S. Code Analysis Tool (CAT) to the One Big Beautiful Bill Act as a proof of concept to show how CAT can support rapid statutory triage by identifying which statutory changes warrant closer review.
title_cn: Mapping Complex Legislation: Applying the RAND U.S. Code Analysis Tool to the One Big Beautiful Bill Act
